integrity: All new proof and verification assets are self-contained. Computations corroborate but do not replace the proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The last class means no termination in the first seven terms, not nontermination. The day-verified dated archival source is arXiv:1108.6118v1; older issue-only literature is cited without inventing exact first-public calendar days.
title: Sharp \(1260\)-conductor for the early odd-greedy length profile of twice prime reciprocals
